implementation_summary: Added a provider-managed Cloud IAM identity-provider create API boundary for tenant-scoped SAML/OIDC registration.
Added path/body provider id binding, tenant binding, authorization surface, request fingerprinting, duplicate-provider mapping, and idempotency replay/drift handling.

Added deterministic tests proving path/body drift is rejected before mutation, OIDC provider registration replays idempotently, duplicate providers map to conflict, and reused idempotency keys map to 422 semantics.
Updated M03-P01/IP-004 status as provider-managed IdP create API green while preserving update/list/delete, provider runtime adapter/sync status, and live-smoke gaps.
